0022600156.text: The Warriors (3-3, on a three-game win streak, 2nd in the Pacific and 10th in the West) host the LA Clippers (1-4, on a four-game losing streak, 4th in the Pacific and 14th in the West) in Golden State's seventh game of the season. Golden State is missing Stephen Curry, Draymond Green, Jimmy Butler III, Kristaps Porzingis and Moses Moody, while Gui Santos is day-to-day with a knee injury and a game-time decision, and the Clippers are without Bradley Beal, Brandon Ingram, Jordan Miller, Max Strus and Yanic Konan Niederhauser. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Warriors lost 1-3, including a 115-110 loss in Los Angeles on April 12, 2026, in the most recent meeting.
